Her background maps well to Redwood's serving/runtime needs (distributed KV cache optimization, kernel-level perf work, and inference orchestration).

- Tue 10 Jun — 10:00–12:00 or 15:00–17:00
- Wed 11 Jun — 09:00–11:00
